company_info.company_description: "We know the local area well, having installed thousands of residential, commercial and industrial solar energy systems over the past decade."

reviews.review_description: SolarGain installed a full suite of 13kw solar panels with accompanying batteries as part of my new build. They did a fantastic job and were very knowledgeable, professional and helpful, particularly given I am not an expert in this area and was relying upon SolarGain to set me up with the right solution for my specific needs (which they did). They also provided excellent after sales service when one of the products failed (through no fault of SolarGain). Bryn (SolarGain CEO) became personally involved and helped broker a great outcome with the manufacturer. I would highly recommend.

From first contact we were very at ease with SolargainThe team said what they would do and when then followed throughCommunication was ongoing and very efficientThe installation team were very prompt polite and professionalWould highly recommend Solargain to anyone

The sales person provided me some good advice on various inverters and provided me a few different quotes until we found one I was comfortable with.Installation went smoothly and the installers did a good job.It took over 3 weeks to organise connection to the grid. I was advised this would maybe take a week so I had to chase this up myself for a couple of weeks which was a bit frustrating.
Very happy with system supplied. Battery was an addition to existing solar.
Quoting easy and quickInstallation two weeks after quote, smooth, punctual, tidyEverything organised for us

Used the most expensive quote but liked the honesty and information from Solargain.Changes to the plan were made on inspection of the site placing two thirds of our panels on the south east side due to shadowing from trees and an adjacent two story house.Only disappointing aspect was that my quote included a timer to alter the hot water from night heating to daytime but thus got lost in the translation.Overall. I’m hoping the system provides us with many years of clean energy operation and yield.

Solargain Hastings did a great job, came out to see the house before quote and was on site doing install within two weeks of quote being accepted. Cleaned up after themselves so overall happy with the job done.

Quote sent very quickly. Phone call from supplier helpful. The installers were fantastic, stinking hot day they made the process look easy. Group of very pleasant young men. Only downfall in whole process was waiting 3 weeks for inspection of system before it could be turned on.
Quoting process was straight forward and quoted on what I needed, installation was professional and site left tidy. Very happy with the team from Solar 360 Hastings
I would recommend this company. We had a great experience with them from salespeople to the installation team. We are happy with our system and how it is working.
The installation team were punctual, tidy & informative.They also modify the design onsite to better suit the actual conditions re shading etc.

They responded quickly, installation was faultless and they informed me throughout. On tone and good follow up. They arranged the grid connection  and showed me how it worked. They advised they would follow up in twelve months to see how it was going.

Great sales and quoting. Great installation team,friendly fast quality. Turned up on time. They are currently organising grid connection. System working as stated. Also had interest solar hot water installed as part of quote.
Excellent service & extremely knowledgeable in their products. Very approachable in all aspects

The crew that installed my 6kw system in Tyabb were the most polite helpful, people I have had do work at my place nothing was to much trouble . They double checked everything & vacuumed before they left brilliant.  Paul

Sales was very helpful, talked me through the whole process and helped me through the paperwork process, so I was left feeling happy with my choice.  Installation was brilliant, they talked me through every stage of installation where everything would go etc.  They were quick, very tidy and cheerful, couldn't have asked for better, thanks guys, great job.

The salesman was knowledgeable  and helpful, without being pushy and had all the paperwork including the subsidies done in  one day.The installation team were punctual, quick and efficient and the young man who came the day after to connect  the system to the Internet was knowledgeable and most  courteous, without being condescending (my wife and I are both in our late 70s.)I could not recommend them highly enough
reviews.panel_brand: Q CELLS PEAK DUO ML G10+ 415W (Other)

reviews.review_description: Solargain were very helpfull in choosing equipment suitable for a coastal environment.Installation staff were very professional, courteous and friendly, they went about the install with no fuss. They arrived on time and kept us informed of the installation. Very tidyUnfortnately still waiting for them to i gorm service provider for grid connection. .

Sales quoting was good. Included metre box upgrade and sales person visited site to assist with inspection which we appreciated.Installation team were very good. A complicated job with old wiring but they were very thorough and completed a great job.  Site was cleaned up after job which I thought was very professional and a good rap for the company. I have heard of other companies leaving all the packaging behind.

We didn't go with the cheapest quote but with the company we felt the most comfortable with and who really listened to what we needed. Julian, our solar specialist was great to deal with,  nothing was too hard and dealt with in a very timely manner. He was very polite, friendly and professional all whilst making us feel totally at ease with our choice. The whole prices was seemless and cyborgs very quickly. Installers were tidy,  punctual and respectful of us and our property.This is my 3rd solar system and I've spoken with many solar retailers over the years and these guys are definitely the best by far.Would recommend Solargain Hastings to anyone wanting a solar system that is quality and a great team behind the system. 6 stars from us

Such a professional team. Nothing was an issue. Everything explained so well by the sales guy, Will and we asked him lots of questions, on multiple occasions until we decided to go ahead. Very competitive on pricing. The installation crew matched this, punctual, respectful, explained everything to me. Experienced team. We got other electrical work done on the property at the same time, that other electricians previously didn’t seem keen to do- nothing seemed an issue for these guys.  We are now getting a battery and using the same team again. Thank you!

The sales and quoting process was unique and quick.  Distinct from other competitors, it involved a site visit and on site quote with everything taken into account.  Consequently no changes or variations were required to their original quote.  The installation process was scheduled in advance, the installers were punctual, competent, polite and informative throughout.  Customer service throughout was excellent.  They organised the grid connection and inspection which occurred approximately 5 days after installation had been completed.

Sales experience was top notch, Bryn was very knowledgeable and no BS. Accounts let the team down  as I had to chase up whether payment was received.The installers were very efficient and did a very neat installation.This system was installed to add to an existing 2.5kw array. I have been having problems with the new inverter shutting down when the Fronius App shows 2.5kw exported, the problem is, the new system may show only 1.8kw total being generated. Somehow the inverter is seeing the output from the old system .This has been raised with Bryn, unfortunately he has gone on leave and had passed this on to a colleague. At this stage, I have had to follow up myself, still not resolved.Sad, as I had been very impressed with other aspects of the project.
Very happy from first contact to install very happy with the team
It all went really smoothly and we are very happy with the system we installed and the customer service provided. We highly recommend Solargain Hastings!
All went well.  Just took much longer than promised to get installed and still haven't got it certified.
still wonderful all around  and still happy with every aspect.
Sales was responsive. Installation was tidy and punctual. Not yet operational waiting for inspection - a few days.

All aspects of the process were very good. I was particularly impressed by the in person attendance at my home for the preparation of the quote. Prompt communication at every step of the process was great. Installation team were terrific. Inspection happened 3 working days after installation. Very happy.
Sales quote was very good everything laid out and itemisedEveryone very polite and respectfulVery punctualGrid connection all taken care of by Solargain
Installers were polite, incredibly tidy and supportive.Everything from quote to after sales we were extremely happy with.

Excellent company to deal with.Communication was excellent - Given a multiple range of choices. Did not go with the cheapestNever felt pressuredExtremely neat jobHave recommended them to many other people interested in solarSo glad I went with a battery. Have not had a single power bill since installing, and am earning credits.

Excellent service and everything explained. All questions answered and explained to our understanding. Installers polite and friendly. Solargain Hastings were the only solar company that came out to our property and explained everything we needed to know, that is after getting 5 quotes. I would have no hesitation in recommending them.

Solar gain was on the ball, upfront quote, not that cheap, installation within 7 days, good bunch of blokes doing the install, grid connection within 10 days, all in all absolutely recommend this outfit for a quality install.
Sales process good and professionalQuality installationOn time, friendly Installation team.Good communication all through the process

Quoting process was really good. Contacted by four companies and all provided a friendly, reliable experience.Solargain were easy to deal with. Still a little bit of effort required but much less than i anticipated.Installation was good. Feel confident with them and their after sales service.
Accurate information, quality installation, excellent customer support helping with the steps to connect to grid.Explanation on use of AppAll up easy process from the quote to the installation.
Great company to deal with, polite, tidy and on time. Ensured paperwork was done just waiting for regulator to inspect.
They were promt and very efficient.The hole the team were helpful and courteous.Definitely wouldn't hesitate to deal with them again or recommend them.

What impressed me was that Mark came to the site to personally inspect the proposed sure. The other companies have similar quotes but missed a couple of details. It have me confidence that three install would go smoothly. Three install did go smoothly. The team turned up on time, worked cleanly and got everything done despite some miserable weather.Note that the property did not qualify for state rebates as it's a farm.

The sale quoting process was very goodWas polite, Tidy, punctual and friendlyCustomer Service was great very professional and they help organise grid connection after installationSolar is now up and running.
From the salesperson who was extremely pleasant, knowledgeable and realistic to the installers who were very polite, efficient and friendly, this was a good experience.

Very good customer service. Installers were very professional and polite. All necessary actions were taken by the installer up to and including my final inspection tomorrow. Very good service and follow through with my queries from the sales rep.
Sales and quoting was professional and easy and catered to our needs.

Juist replaced my 3kw 10 yr old solar with a new 8kw system, Solar 365 were great to deal with, prompt service, knowledgeable sales staff and quick installation by a great team, the system is performing above what I expected, on a sunny day 58KWh, I had half the panels facing NE and the other NW, taking advantage of sunlight all day, very happy with Solar 365.

Solar 360 Provided fantastic personalised service. None of this doing it all over the phone they were there and available for me to contact at any time about any aspect of the installation. Josh was my contact person and was, and still is, fantastic; continuing to be there to follow up with bill costs. The installation team are fantastic too. Recommended by my neighbour. Word-of-mouth is very important. Couldn’t recommend them highly enough and we are supporting local business.
Salesman explained everything clearly, no pressure to sign.Whole process went smoothly.Quick and neat installation.

The quoting process was good and I was given several options from basic, mid and top systems and everything was fully explained however, they messed up with the installation arrangements blaming the computer system but I was not convinced.  The guys who installed were excellent very professional, polite and tidy and informative especially as the weather was not great but they carried on to get the system installed for christmas.  Still waiting on someone to come out and give it the tick of approval so that we can be connected.  Do not get this done over the holiday period as everything takes ages to get approved and connected (not the fault of the installer).  Hopefully its all good and we will be up and running asap.
Have done my heatpump HWS and solar panels. Great workmanship and very good dealing with all the paperwork. Even used the plumber I requested.

There were a few follow-up phone calls and Solar 360 were always polite and well informed. Our only problem is that the inverter keeps shutting down we think because of the voltage in our area. Solar 360 has contacted United Energy but it is still proving a problem.

Panels and system installed very quickly.I would highly recommend Solar360 Australia to get panels and inverter installed.Their service is fantastic, they care about the customer and are still following up as panels are not yet connected to the grid.Still struggling with my energy supplier (Energy Australia) to get the panels connected to the grid.I will possibly change energy suppliers in the future once I know exactly what they can offer.
